11	 * frozen contract — runtime inspection targets CheckoutViewModel.applyDiscount().

16	
17	    val quantity: Int
18	        get() = currentQuantity

21	        currentQuantity = value.coerceIn(1, 10)
22	    }

25	        val discountFactor = 1.0 - min(currentQuantity, 10) * 0.035
26	        val totalDollars = (UNIT_PRICE * currentQuantity * discountFactor).roundToInt()
27	        return "$$totalDollars"
28	    }
29	
30	    companion object {
31	        const val UNIT_PRICE = 9.37
32	    }
33	}

comparative run**. Sweep executed on the bench (mini), stock + seeded debug
